cli.status.empty: No active sessions. (Start one with e.g. `guard dev agy`.)
cli.help:
🛡️  Guard - AI Agent R/W Guardrail CLI
Usage:
  guard init [flags]      # Initialize guard hook, policy, and workflow rules for this workspace
  guard doctor [--fix]    # Diagnose workspace configuration and auto-fix issues (--json supported)
  guard <cmd...>          # Run command in current default mode + auto-register Skill (e.g. guard agy)
  guard dev [cmd...]      # Switch to DEV mode or run command in DEV mode (e.g. guard dev agy)
  guard test [cmd...]     # Switch to TEST mode or run command in TEST mode
  guard plan [cmd...]     # Switch to PLAN mode or run command in PLAN mode
  guard all [cmd...]      # Switch to ALL mode or run command in ALL mode
  guard status            # Show current policy and active session summary
  guard top               # Launch real-time TUI Control Tower (alias: guard ui)
  guard clean [--all]     # Clean terminated stale sessions (--all: delete all sessions)
  guard reset <sessionId> # Reset violation count for a specific session
  guard doc               # Print AI Few-shot policy schema and guard-policy.yaml sample
  guard hook              # Run Antigravity PreToolUse hook (auto-detected on piped stdin)

   • Verify setup : guard doctor
   • Start session: guard dev agy (monitor with 'guard top' in another terminal)
   • Tune policy  : edit guard-policy.yaml to customize project rules
